_readme: Copy to ~/.hermes/plugin-data/home-dashboard/live-actions/<name>.json and edit. Cards can only name these ids. command is an argv list run WITHOUT a shell; {name} placeholders are filled with args checked against the schema below. Unknown keys starting with _ are ignored.

actions.label: Say hello
actions.description: Prints a greeting. Harmless; good for a first test.

actions.label: Back up now
actions.description: Runs the nightly backup script once.

actions.label: Stop job
actions.confirm: The job stops right away. Its unit can be started again later.

actions.label: Retry build
actions.description: Asks the local CI runner to retry the last build.
actions.note: set the token and enable it
